name: handler_rstudio
title: Progression Handler: Progress Reported in the RStudio Console

origin.description: Build a progression handler that adds an RStudio job.
origin.usage: handler_rstudio(intrusiveness = getOption("progressr.intrusiveness.gui", 1), target = "gui", title = function() format(Sys.time(), "Console %X"), ...)

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default reads progressr.intrusiveness.gui, or 1.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "gui".

arguments.name: title
arguments.text: Job name, a string or a function. The default formats the current time.

origin.details: The handler is returned. A 2-step progressor with enable=TRUE reaches rstudioapi::jobAdd(), which stops because rstudioapi is not installed.
origin.value: A function of class progression_handler. Running it looks up a package that is not installed.

translation.description: Build a progression handler that would add an RStudio job.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default reads progressr.intrusiveness.gui, or 1.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "gui".

arguments.name: title
arguments.text: Job name, a string or a function. The default formats the current time.

translation.details: The handler is returned. Running it with enable=True reaches the rstudioapi lookup and stops. Pass enable=True; a disabled handler does not call its reporter.
translation.value: A function of class progression_handler. Running it looks up a package that is not installed.
translation.example:
from progressr.evaluate import with_progress
from progressr.external import handler_rstudio
from progressr.options import ProgressrError
from progressr.progressor import progressor

def body():
    progress = progressor(steps=2, on_exit=False)
    progress()
    progress()

try:
    with_progress(body, handlers=handler_rstudio(enable=True), enable=True, interval=0, delay_terminal=False, delay_stdout=False, delay_conditions=())
except ProgressrError as exc:
    print(f"handler_rstudio() errors: {exc}.")
